comment: Love this teacher so much! She not only provides so much support for each project, she helps review all deliverables and assignments and teaches us so much about client interactions. Would recommend to anyone wanting to get more involved and passionate about marketing!

Dr. Hanson is the best professor ever! She is very understanding and she makes the material understandable and easy. Her lectures are amazing and she uses real life examples to make the concepts applicable. Would 100% recommend.

If you have the opportunity to take a class with Dr. Hanson, do it. She is easily one of the best professors in the business school. She often involves current events into the class to apply what you're learning to the real world. Her exams clearly reflect study guides, homework, and other quizzes. She's the best and really cares about her students
she just makes life easy. easy to balance this class with the rest of my god awful classes this semester.

Super nice person who knows a lot about marketing. Genuinely cares about students and their feedback. Drops lowest test grade. Group project is a lot of work and her feedback can be unclear at times, but if you go to her shes super helpful.

Professor Hanson is so awesome. She genuinely cares about her students and them doing well, so she is always available outside of class. Her lectures are awesome and you can tell how passionate she is about what she does. Study for her tests with the study guides she gives and you'll be just fine!

Hanson is one of the nicest professors that I have had. That said, she very much cares about upholding the integrity of her grading scales/rubrics so don't expect her friendly nature to appear on your grades. One thing that is a little bothersome is that her tests are strange and they always have purposeful curveballs in them. Overall good!

Hanson is a great professor and makes class really interesting (at least for me), but she is a really weird grader that doesn't truly reflect what you know sometimes. You have to read the textbook, and she sometimes has homework questions corresponding. Overall, I do very much enjoy the class, but not when it comes test/project time.
